videos.title: 575 - Who is classifying IPv6 prefixes from T-SQL?
videos.description:
575 - Classify IPv6 prefixes from T-SQL. That's the demo example they picked, after showing PDFs and emails. The real story got buried under a networking use case nobody asked for.

https://youtu.be/oB9GQPX_7Fc

#fabric #tsql #powerbi #dataengineering

videos.title: 574 - Stop using AI to answer questions
videos.description:
574 - Stop using AI to answer your questions. It's not good at that. Use it to build the systems and tools that answer them. Satya's note on the software factory and cheap local AI says the same thing.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#aiagents #softwarefactory #satyanadella #aistrategy #dataengineering

videos.title: 574 - I bring my own harness to Fabric
videos.description:
574 - Not relying on the agents Microsoft hands you. Bring your own harness into Fabric and build whatever you want inside it. Custom harnesses are where working with agents is going.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#aiagents #microsoftfabric #agentharness #dataengineering #developers

videos.title: 574 - Most companies are still stuck in the sandbox
videos.description:
574 - Plenty of organizations aren't building their own agents at all. They're pushing Copilot, and the advanced ones made it to Copilot Studio. That's the question here, asked on behalf of everyone still in the sandbox.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#copilot #copilotstudio #microsoftfabric #aiadoption #dataengineering

videos.title: 574 - Does anyone even use Fabric data agents?
videos.description:
574 - When was the last time you opened Fabric to use Copilot or the data agent for real work? You can't bring them skills. You can't do the other stuff. So who's actually using them?

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#microsoftfabric #fabricdataagent #copilot #aiagents #dataengineering

videos.title: 574 - Agent built an ontology viewer in 15 minutes
videos.description:
574 - Fifteen minutes, one existing ontology YAML file, and an agent built a full graphical interface with draggable cards showing how everything relates. The spec is public, so the agent could go read what the relationships mean.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#ontology #aiagents #yaml #dataengineering #vibecoding

videos.title: 574 - For a pilot today, use the semantic model
videos.description:
574 - Running a pilot right now? The semantic model still has relationships, measures, and a way to hide and show. Not fully cooked, but the ingredients are there. OneLake is the cooler option and still the wrong one.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#semanticmodel #onelake #microsoftfabric #powerbi #dataengineering

videos.title: 574 - Pick the open standard, not the proprietary one
videos.description:
574 - Building a proprietary ontology locks you into one way of thinking. The OSI group already has smart people working the spec, with Databricks and Snowflake at the table. Pick the thing that outlives your project.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#ontology #opensource #opensemanticinterchange #microsoftfabric #datastrategy

videos.title: 574 - Shop your ontology like a grocery store
videos.description:
574 - Walk the aisles of your ontology, pull a customer table, grab two metrics and a fact table, and watch a semantic model build itself in front of you. Hit checkout and it's yours. Direct Lake is what makes that possible.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#ontology #directlake #semanticmodel #microsoftfabric #powerbi

videos.title: 574 - Who gets to see which tables in your ontology?
videos.description:
574 - Finance tables linked to customer and sales are valid enterprise semantics. That doesn't mean the sales team should see them. Who's sanctioned for which tables in an ontology, and does this just become row-level security everywhere?

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#ontology #datasecurity #rowlevelsecurity #datagovernance #microsoftfabric

videos.title: 574 - Tag a table description to auto-join your ontology
videos.description:
574 - Drop a line in your table description that says for use in ontology A, weight 0.7. The ontology agent searches every description in Fabric and pulls the matches in on its own. No more hand-picking models one at a time.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#ontology #microsoftfabric #metadata #dataagents #semanticlayer

videos.title: 574 - You fixed one model. The other five didn't change
videos.description:
574 - You add descriptions and instructions to one semantic model to make it AI ready. Now where does that work go? Nothing today carries it up to the other five models with the same customers table.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#semanticmodel #powerbi #aiready #microsoftfabric #datamodeling

videos.title: 574 - Synapse and Data Factory are gone
videos.description:
574 - Someone asked about Data Factory this week. Synapse, resource groups, the way you used to do data engineering, all of it is gone. Medallion survived. The old mental model can't stretch to agents in Fabric.

https://youtu.be/qQ8GfnMReO4

#microsoftfabric #dataengineering #synapse #datafactory #aiagents
